text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Run through the 'Shuka Sho' and carve my 
hoofprints into the history of the Triple 
Tiara...!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(Carve the name of Chrono Genesis... into 
history!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(To stand shoulder-to-shoulder as an equal 
with those illustrious Tiara Umamusume... 
For that, I must!)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I shall demonstrate my power through 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis surges, she's pulling 
ahead!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"For the sake of everyone I've run 
alongside so far. I will do thisâwith 
these legs!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Curren Bouquetd'or refuses to back down 
either!

text_block_list.name: Chrono & Bouquet
text_block_list.text: Taaaaaaaahhhhh! Yaaaaaaaaahhhhh!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Chrono Genesis has broken away! She 
crosses the finish line in the lead!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"Claiming the final Tiara is Chrono 
Genesis!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
*pant, gasp*... The Shuka Sho tiara... I 
did it...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
(I carved... a trail of hoofprints all my 
own. One that rivals the greatest 
Umamusume in history.)

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: (This time, I can really feel it...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! That final burst of speed was 
amazing! So cool!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Her running has completely transformed! 
Now I'm really looking forward to her 
races in the Senior Class!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I mean, the Tiara route lately has been 
crazy hype! Both Almond Eye's generation 
and this one! The Tiara Umamusume are just 
way too strong!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"It seems they've acknowledged... the 
strength of our generation. What a 
relief."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
Just as you said, Chrono-san— I'm glad I 
kept giving it my all, step by steady 
step.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: Once again— congratulations, Chrono-san.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: "Bouquet-san... Thank you so much...!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I have carved my hoofprints into 
the Shuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"According to the Genesis Method's 
forecast, first place wasn't a 100% 
probability, but—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I was able to head into it with full 
confidence that I could win.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: That is the greatest takeaway of all...!
choice_data_list: Yeah. You've grown so much mentally too!
Yeah. You've grown a lot mentally, too!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... If you feel that way too, 
Trainer, then I'm glad...
choice_data_list:
You don't pale in comparison to any 
historical Umamusume at all!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
! G-Geez... If you praise me that much, I 
feel like it'll go straight to my head...
choice_data_list: Why not, at least for today!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Nice, nice! The Shuka Sho was one blazing 
120-mile race!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I wanna run soon too! My legs are 
itching for action!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I can understand that. After 
witnessing a race like that, who wouldn't?

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah! It's Loves Only You! Wait, Gran 
Alegria is here too! Are they for real!?

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
Idiot, put "-san" at the end of her name! 
My apologies!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, the real Gran Alegria is here! Good 
mile-ning!

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer A
text_block_list.text:
G-Good mor-mile... I was watching the Oka 
Sho and the Yushun Himba...!

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I remember the way both of you 
ran! That's why the Shuka Sho was such a 
shame, but..."

text_block_list.name: Race Cafe Customer B
text_block_list.text:
I'm really looking forward to racing 
against the older generation! Well then, 
thanks for having me!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
...Come to think of it, everyone here came 
to watch the Shuka Sho, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Our generation— it's getting a 
hundred miles worth of attention!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: ...And that's what happened!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I was worried that people might 
compare me to Ai-san and underestimate my 
abilities, but—

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
That wasn't the case at all. The Shuka Sho 
really drove that home for me.

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why— I'll have to keep 
doing my best going forward.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Let's use today's Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
to devise our strategy against the Senior 
Class...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the final Sunday of October, deep into 
autumn. I had come to watch the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To study Almond Eye, whom I will likely 
clash with in a race before long.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: "Ai-san, was your last race a 1600m one?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In the end, it was a 3rd-place 
finish, but it was a defeat that showed 
immense strength.

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Right, right! Even after getting boxed in 
and falling way behind, she still caught 
up!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
That finishing burst gave me 30 miles of 
shivers!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"From our generation— two of us are 
running, right?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. In particular, the Satsuki Sho 
Umamusume is the 2nd favorite, a 
formidable contender!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Judging by her record, today's 2000m is 
her best distance. Even against 
Senior-class opponents, we have high 
hopes.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If there's any cause for concern, it's 
Tokyo Racecourse— the very place of her 
only defeat in the Japanese Derby...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"To be honest, I lack sufficient data to 
make a proper judgment, so it is a point I 
am hesitant about as well..."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Anyway, that makes her the representative 
of our generation!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes...! For example, Classic-class 
Umamusume who have won the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn) include—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Bubble Gum Fellow, Symboli Kris S is here.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
I believe that this time as well, there's 
a very good chance...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Mmm, I want my classmates to do their 
best! But I want to be the first one to 
beat Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text: 20-Mile Dilemma~~~!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... I understand that feeling a little 
bit.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"...Ai-san's true worth will also be put 
to the test in this race..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
What kind of hoofprints will she leave 
behind, I wonder—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the gates of the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
burst open.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye is in 6th, 7th position! Now 
entering the final straight and heading up 
the hill!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san is along the inner rail. That's 
going to be a tough spot to break out 
from."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, the Umamusume on the outside is 
putting on the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
This time, Eye-san drew Gate 2 in Bracket 
1. As expected, she took the innermost 
rail early on, so you could say boxing her 
in is the only option.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
There's a wall of runners in front of her. 
With how packed it is, she can't break 
through.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Still, that's within expectations.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
"There's always a split second where a 
tiny gap opens up! All you gotta do is 
dive right into it."

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
“—Now!! I won't let this moment slip 
away!”

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: She goes for the inside!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
In the split second the front shifted...! 
What incredible judgment!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
She breaks away completely! She's 
unstoppable! Almond Eye crosses the finish 
line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text: —A-amazing...

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Did you pull ahead by about 0.0045 miles? 
That's awesome! Must've felt so good!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that final kick is as impressive as 
ever. With this, the time should also—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
The time is in! ...0.1 seconds off the 
record!? So close!

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye is seriously legendary! We're 
witnessing history in the making...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
Didn't manage to break the record, huh. 
That's a shame, Ai-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The record Tosen Jordan set in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
It's a shocking time that shaves a full 
1.1 seconds off the previous record.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
And Ai-san, who is closing in on her... is 
moving at a truly phenomenal speed as 
well.
choice_data_list:
Tomorrow's papers are going to be 
incredible too

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: You're right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Sure enough, the next day's newspapers 
mostly featured Almond Eye on their front 
pages.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
The newspapers and the news are completely 
dominated by Ai-san's Tenno Sho (Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Just when things were getting so exciting 
with the Shuka Sho and the Kikuka Sho. 
It's all vanished into thin air..."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes... That being said, given Ai-san's 
record, it's only natural...

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
With yesterday's Tenno Sho (Autumn), we 
have achieved 6 GⅠ victories, including 
overseas races.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
As of now, she has tied Orfevre-san and 
Gold Ship-san in total GⅠ victories.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
She is just one win away from matching the 
record for the most turf GⅠ victories at 7 
wins.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Ahaha... That's way too crazy...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"However—what we must do remains 
unchanged."

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"Just as beforeâ I simply need to run 
the race in front of me with all my 
might."

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Thanks to that, my strength was 
properly acknowledged.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text: Just as Chrono-chan said before.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"Nothing changes for me, I'll just keep 
walking my own path. Actually, I'm 
thinking about taking on challenges 
overseas, too♪"

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to test my limits... and see how 
far I can go overseas.

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
Besides, if I win, mightn't I steal the 
spotlight even more than Ai-san?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Indeed... If that's the case—!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"How about all of us master our own 
respective paths...?!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Ai-san's popularity is tremendous... 
Surpassing her in buzz will be an uphill 
battle."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
“Yet, if it's in our respective 
specialties, we might just be able to 
surpass Ai-san—!”

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
For instance, if Love-chan could perform 
even better in overseas races than 
Ai-san...!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I see. Then I'm going for the Mile, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Fortunately, we are aiming in different 
directions. That is precisely why we can 
shine in a variety of arenas."

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
If everyone achieves top-tier results on 
their respective paths— we might just kick 
up a massive whirlwind...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
"By combining the feats of everyone in our 
generation— we will surpass Ai-san, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Even from a historical racing 
perspective, I believe we can make our 
generation unforgettable...!

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
"By combining the strength of our whole 
generation, each individual gets more 
spotlight too... I think that's 
wonderful!"

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
I'm 100% in for the Mile! When it comes to 
mile races, there's no way I'm losing to 
Ai-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Let us master our own paths and, 
together, build a generation uniquely our 
own!"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
"Love-chan is heading overseas, Gran-chan 
to the miles. Then as for me—"

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: I want to walk the royal road.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
The history of Umamusume racing has always 
been woven alongside the classic route, 
after all.
choice_data_list: That's so like Chrono, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her desire to “master the classic royal 
road” perfectly matched the next race I 
had prepared for her.
choice_data_list:
How about the Osaka Hai for your next 
race?

How about the Osaka Hai for your next 
race?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text: Yes, I have no objections.

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Starting from the Osaka Hai, I shall carve 
my hoofprints into the Senior Class royal 
road...!
